parameters.name: paymentGatewayAccountId
parameters.description: Filter by the PaymentGatewayAccount the Terminal belongs to.

parameters.name: paymentGatewayId
parameters.description: Filter by the PaymentGateway the Terminal belongs to.

parameters.name: storeId
parameters.description: Filter by the Store the Terminal is bound to.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by Terminal status. When omitted, deleted Terminals are excluded.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: A cursor for pagination across multiple pages of results. Don’t include this parameter on the first call. Use the `nextStart` value returned in a previous response to request subsequent results.
